# Data dictionary

*Generated by `scripts/make_data_dictionary.py` from the migrated schema (migrations 0001-0004). Provenance and limits are at the end.*

## `alerts`

Baseline alert table derived from inventory and forecasts.

| Column | Type | Null | Default / constraint |
|---|---|---|---|
| id | bigint | no | nextval('alerts_id_seq'::regclass) |
| created_at | timestamp with time zone | no | now() |
| scenario_key | text | no | 'baseline'::text |
| location_id | text | no |  |
| supply_id | text | no |  |
| severity | text | no |  |
| days_cover | double precision | no |  |
| stockout_date | date | yes |  |
| lead_days | double precision | no |  |
| message | text | no |  |

Constraints: `alerts_severity_check`: CHECK ((severity = ANY (ARRAY['CRITICAL'::text, 'WARNING'::text]))); `alerts_location_id_fkey`: FOREIGN KEY (location_id) REFERENCES locations(id); `alerts_supply_id_fkey`: FOREIGN KEY (supply_id) REFERENCES supplies(id); `alerts_pkey`: PRIMARY KEY (id)

## `inventory`

Current stock, initial (seeded) stock and safety stock per location and supply. Only the CURRENT level is stored: there is no daily on-hand history.

| Column | Type | Null | Default / constraint |
|---|---|---|---|
| location_id | text | no |  |
| supply_id | text | no |  |
| stock | numeric | no |  |
| safety_stock | numeric | no | 0 |
| initial_stock | numeric | no |  |
| updated_at | timestamp with time zone | no | now() |

Constraints: `inventory_safety_stock_check`: CHECK ((safety_stock >= (0)::numeric)); `inventory_stock_check`: CHECK ((stock >= (0)::numeric)); `inventory_location_id_fkey`: FOREIGN KEY (location_id) REFERENCES locations(id); `inventory_supply_id_fkey`: FOREIGN KEY (supply_id) REFERENCES supplies(id); `inventory_pkey`: PRIMARY KEY (location_id, supply_id)

| stock_after | numeric | no |  |

| event_id | text | yes |  |

Constraints: `iot_events_event_type_check`: CHECK ((event_type = ANY (ARRAY['RECEIVE'::text, 'ISSUE'::text, 'COUNT'::text]))); `iot_events_quantity_check`: CHECK ((quantity >= (0)::numeric)); `iot_events_simulated_check`: CHECK (simulated); `iot_events_stock_nonneg`: CHECK (((stock_before >= (0)::numeric) AND (stock_after >= (0)::numeric))); `iot_events_location_id_fkey`: FOREIGN KEY (location_id) REFERENCES locations(id); `iot_events_supply_id_fkey`: FOREIGN KEY (supply_id) REFERENCES supplies(id); `iot_events_pkey`: PRIMARY KEY (id)

## Provenance, units and limits

| Data | Origin | Real or simulated | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|
| Locations, depots, vehicles, routes, terrain, weather, consumption, initial inventory | `backend/scripts/generate_seed.py` (deterministic, seed 2026) -> `db/seed.sql` | **Simulated, fictional** | Coordinates are fictional grid points. Units are abstract "units" per supply class; distances in km; speeds in km/h; times in hours/days. 5 forward locations x 10 supplies x 110 days of consumption. Nothing maps to a real place, unit or stock. |
| Weather index | same generator | **Simulated** | No weather service is connected. |
| Inventory events (`iot_events`) | the built-in software simulator or a user's API call | **Simulated** | No ESP32/RFID hardware exists in this project. |
| Forecasts, alerts, priorities, allocations, simulation runs | computed by the application | **Model/rule outputs** | Predictions and recommendations, not observations. |
| ISOMORPH benchmark | external, CC-BY-4.0 (ISOMORPH Sample), documented in `ml/DATA_CARD.md` | **Simulator-generated benchmark** (13-node US supply chain digital twin) | Not bundled. Used only to train/evaluate the shipped model artefacts. Results are not observations of any real operation, least of all Indian Army operations. |
| `Dataset_AI_Supply_Optimization.csv` | provided with the project | **Unknown provenance** | Profiled only (`ml/reports/supply_csv_profile.json`); not used for training, tuning or any displayed figure. No keys, dates or locations exist to form a time series. |
| Public geographic/terrain data | **none used** | - | Terrain classes in the scenario are fictional labels. No elevation or road dataset is bundled; the schema (PostGIS geometry columns) allows one to be added later. |
| Validated real-world operational observations | **none** | - | The project contains no such data. |

Units: stock and demand in abstract units/day; `days_left` in days; ETA in hours; risk indices 0-100; weather index 0-1.
